reviews.t: Just like Bobbi Boss Nu Locs
reviews.x: I loved this hair ! It’s very convenient not having to extend the short lengths together! My clients Iove this hair as well. It’s hard trying to find 24inch length so don’t wait just buy it ! 3/4 packs for a full head!

I loveee this hair. It’s very true to length and quality  on 10 . It’s also very natural looking. 5 packs is what I used. It was very full. Definitely will buy again 💕 ive gotten so many compliments ‼️

reviews.t: My new favorite faux loc company
reviews.x: The hair is perfect! No complaints. I installed it myself. They even better as they age. Absolutely amazing. I’m 5’5 and the hair touches my butt. I love long full hair. I only used 4 packs. I have a smaller head shape. Will buy again!

I am completely satisfied with my order . I got the 30 inch locs in 1B and I am loving the length ! I am 5”4’ & 3/4 and it goes a little bit past my butt. It took 4 hours to install and I was so surprised that I only used 3 packs because I have A LOT of hair . I also bought spring twist hair to wrap down the length of my natural hair to achieve this style . I love it , it’s so cute and I’ve been getting sooo many compliments . Would definitely recommend !

[[VIDEOID:3ee312d1de82c5fe87dadd0804f34e12]] In love! These are great, the most realistic looking faux locs I’ve ever seen! I thought they would be a little longer on me, but the 24” reaches my lower back & I am 5’3

reviews.t: Expensive but just like the nu locs
reviews.x: Really nice but A lil expensive i think.. long like i wanted . I actually cut them a lil and in layers bc my stylist put too many in my head. It was a lot.. i like them overall.

Locs were long and looked very nice when arrived. The crochet loop can be difficult to find. Otherwise used for individual locs and look cute on my daughter. Just were a silk bonnet because they become tangled and stick together. Using the unused portion for another style.

[[VIDEOID:f9df104c05d17d71cbcf5b6b112587b3]] I was first very skeptical of ordering these locs online but I am SO GLAD that I did! The 6pk is literally enough to do two heads! This is what I recommend for all of my clients!

[[VIDEOID:d8e96cbffa90e103f2f61aaaa6d417f4]] Bought this hair for my mini vacation and I must say I’m inlove with it. It was kinda heavy at first because I almost used all 6 packs but after a while it feels like nothing is on my head. I’d definitely be ordering some more colors soooooon..

Niseyo soft locs are some of the best pre-made locs that I have worked with ! I’ve never had any issues with any of the hair I have purchased. The pre-made loops are small and allow me to achieve an effortless flat install. All of my clients pics that I’ve attached have Niseyo locs installed. No complaints here! <3 I’m an Atlanta based faux loc stylist. Check me out on Instagram- @therawxperience

reviews.t: Pretty Locs and easy to install
reviews.x: Great value for the money. Good color match, after I had done Henna on my grey hair to match the dark brown. At 65 with some gray hair it's hard to find long pretty Grey princess, butterfly or faux locs in grey. I used 4pks (strands are plentiful in each pack). There is weight to them once in. I'll enjoy this still for 2mos.

The hair can be cut without unraveling I would suggest an apple cider vinegar soak before installing the hair. I used the traditional crotchet method to install this hair. The color is vibrant, the locs are of soft and not heavy at all.

For my hair personally I wasn’t able to pull my natural hair into the loc and hide it. So I used kinky hair and had to wrap around just at the top until it passed my hair then freeze sprayed it down.  It’s very good quality. I never can leave hair in for more than a week, I get bored. But this hair is beautiful it’s been a month and I’m sad to take it out. It also only took 3/6 packages to do my whole head. So now I have 3 left to redo it yay♥️

[[VIDEOID:7eea2209dc9c0d65a29381fd25e3bad6]] I got soooo many compliments! I did them myself and the older they got the better they looked. They are extremely light and super soft. Not to mention how real they look. I love that they didn’t have that shiny look like most others have. These will be the only brand I purchase going forward.
The packs had 20 pieces in each pack which is amazing most packs have no more than 12. I was able to use this hair from one purchase on 2 clients. This will definitely be my go to for now on.
The hair felt very brittle and dry. Almost like straw. Returned it immediately!! Definitely would of dried out my hair.

[[VIDEOID:5c743f451feec3e5a41dbe2e4314e815]] Really liked the hair and the price. Easy install. I did individual locs and no the crochet method and I still had some locs left! I would recommend this hair!
The hair is soft and it's light but it sheds a lot. I never had faux loc that she'd. I don't not like the hair but I don't like the hair. If that make since. I wish I can send back but I used it.

This hair is amazing! I almost hate to give it top marks because it may affect stock or the price. But, I have to give credit where its due, the hair is simply fantastic! I wore it for 4 months and this hair didn’t miss a beat. It was nice and full. My stylist only used 4 of 6 packs. The hair is soft, lightweight and beautiful.  I’ll include pictures if i can figure it out.  The only reason I took it down was to try a new style.  However, I just ordered more for another install.  In the interest

I absolutely love this hair! I ordered the 30 inches and they stop well below my waist. I only used 3 of the 6 packs so I’ll be able to do this style all over again. It’s been about 3 weeks and the hair still looks great, I have a feeling they’re going to last for a couple months with maintenance. Plus they’re very natural looking! So glad I decided to try these on myself, definitely an easy install. Highly recommend.

I like them. I got the 30 inch in the color 30 I think. I only had to use four packs out of the six they gave me. I just used the extra in the future to touch ups which help me keep the style for a month. They do tend to unravel like the second week of installing so if you don’t mind rewrapping the locs then get em. I got a lot of compliments on my hair. Will be ordering again soon

First off,  they are really light weight and soft. The one thing I didnt love is how thin the locs were, so I ended up unraveling them and doing the "wrap" method with crocheting one loc to my daughters braid. It was very easy to use and they came out so nice, will be purchasing again for her next set!

[[VIDEOID:fd2ef797d5dc80ffc871fb4f843c8601]] the hair came in 1 day for prime users, the hair doesn’t irritate the skin and my clients love the length and texture of this hair! It was early to install and I will definitely be ordering again😊
[[VIDEOID:21c6d66e00a219d90be0141b88d23dbb]] Will use these again in multiple colors!!! Can’t wait
Love the hair very similar to Bobbi boss brand

claims.text: Reviewers widely praise the hair's realistic, natural appearance and quality.
Many customers say the locs are true to length and long, often reaching well past the lower back.
Reviewers frequently note good value, with packs containing plenty of strands and enough hair for multiple installs or clients.
Several customers mention the locs are lightweight and soft, though a few note some initial heaviness.
A few reviewers report minor issues such as tangling, difficulty finding the crochet loop, or the hair being a little expensive.
